creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-26: `kan ready -b <name>`, run from a worktree of another repo for a board that lives in a notes repo, printed `✗ kan not initialized (run 'kan init')`. The registry knows the board: `kan ready --all` lists it with its path.

Since a_2naKGoYNg, `-b` takes a board ID across registered projects, and that works from any directory. A board name does not. From `~`, on 2026-10-27: `kan list -b b_2lNzcTaiA` lists that board, and `kan list -b main` prints the same "not initialized" error. The hint is risky as well, since following it would init a new board in the wrong repo.

Possibly: when the cwd has no project and `-b` names a board that exactly one visible registered project has, use it, or say "board <name> is in <path>; run there, or pass its ID". Either way, drop the `kan init` hint when `-b` was given.
title: A board name in -b outside a project says 'not initialized (run kan init)'
